UserDecision: The prior RIDE v2 license-specialist assessment approved Sysinternals for RIDE. RIDE downloads directly from Microsoft and installs on user-supported devices; RIDE does not transfer, publish or distribute Sysinternals copies. There are no legal issues using Sysinternals in RIDE. Do not use generalized redistribution reasoning to block package migration.
